description: Buy, sell and transfer tax of a token, measured by a live buy/sell simulation on Base (honeypot.is) or read from the Token-2022 transfer fee on Solana. Also says if the tax can still be changed (fee setter, owner not renounced, fee authority), fee-exempt lists and max tx/wallet limits. Query token=<address or mint>, optional chain=base|solana. Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

token.description: Token address on Base (0x...) or Solana mint
